purpose: A plain-text preview that exposes a disclosure control only when its line limit is exceeded.
behaviorProvider: Measured plain-text disclosure using ResizeObserver and shared Button.

component: Accept plain text only and normalize collapsedLines to at least one. Keep a hidden clamped measurement copy separate from the visible text.
Measure overflow on content/line changes, resize and font loading. Render the disclosure only when the measured text exceeds the preview height.
host: Provide localized expand/collapse labels and readable prose width.
Own controlled state updates; keep interactive/rich content out of this plain-text preview.

requirements.statement: Accept plain text only and normalize collapsedLines to at least one. Keep a hidden clamped measurement copy separate from the visible text.
Measure overflow on content/line changes, resize and font loading. Render the disclosure only when the measured text exceeds the preview height.
Use controlled expanded when supplied or local defaultExpanded state otherwise, and emit onExpandedChange. The button exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls.
If resize/content change removes a focused disclosure, move focus to the visible text before removing the control. Disconnect observers/listeners on unmount.
Provide localized expand/collapse labels and readable prose width.
Own controlled state updates; keep interactive/rich content out of this plain-text preview.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Visual line clamping does not redact text from the DOM or guarantee assistive technologies read only the preview.
Requires browser layout measurement; server markup does not know overflow.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
